chunks: The pilgrim, when he stands at Arafat, comes out from his sins.

key_terms.بِعَرَفَاتٍ: at Arafat, the sacred site of standing during hajj
key_terms.وَقَفَ: stood, referring to the ritual standing

ai.seo_question: How does standing at Arafat affect the pilgrim's sins in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the great merit of hajj, especially the standing at Arafat. It teaches that the pilgrim is relieved of sins through this central act of worship, showing the spiritual purification associated with hajj.
